projects.name: pi
projects.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化 AI Agent 工具箱 | 扩展能力强 | 权限隔离需外部补齐
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular AI agent toolkit with excellent extensibility but external sandboxing required
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产级扩展开发，需自行补齐权限沙箱
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production extension development, with sandboxing added separately
highlights_zh: 单仓拆分为 AI、Agent、CLI、TUI、持久化与遥测等职责清晰的包
提供扩展、技能、提示模板、SDK、RPC 与 npm/git 包分发机制
highlights_en: Well-separated monorepo packages covering AI, agents, CLI, TUI, durability, and telemetry
Supports extensions, skills, prompt templates, SDK, RPC, and npm/git package distribution
concerns_zh: 默认继承宿主进程权限，文件、进程、网络和凭据访问缺乏内置隔离
要求 Node.js 22.19+，且构建脚本存在较长的跨包串行编排
concerns_en: Inherits host-process permissions without built-in isolation for files, processes, network, or credentials
Requires Node.js 22.19+ and relies on lengthy sequential cross-package build orchestration

projects.name: zeroclaw
projects.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台自托管助手基础设施 | 模块化与供应链治理基线优秀
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform autonomous assistant infrastructure with strong modularity and supply-chain governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管生产部署，引入前重点审计插件安全
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production self-hosting; audit plugin security before adoption
highlights_zh: 工作区按运行时、渠道、工具、插件等领域拆 crate，依赖边界清晰
覆盖多平台发布、容器构建与 CI 门禁，并固定基础镜像摘要
highlights_en: Domain-focused workspace crates provide clear dependency boundaries
Cross-platform releases, container builds, CI gates, and pinned image digests strengthen delivery
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心 Rust 实现，无法验证错误处理、并发安全与测试深度
功能与渠道数量庞大，供应链、插件签名及权限隔离仍需持续审计
concerns_en: Core Rust implementations were not sampled, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and test depth
The broad feature and channel surface requires continued auditing of supply-chain, plugin-signing, and permission isolation risks

projects.name: jcode
projects.description: High performance coding agent harness written in Rust, built for heavy multi-agent dev workflows
projects.summary_zh: 生产级高性能多智能体编码助手 | 工程质量基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade high-performance multi-agent coding harness with a strong engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队级重度编码代理场景
projects.recommendation_en: Recommended for team-scale, agent-intensive coding workflows
highlights_zh: 通过全目标检查、Clippy 零警告及多项代码规模与错误处理预算门禁保障质量
按运行时、协议、模型提供方、TUI 与工具能力拆分大量独立 crate，扩展边界清晰
highlights_en: Enforces all-target checks, warning-free Clippy, and multiple code-size and error-handling budget gates
Separates runtime, protocol, providers, TUI, and tool capabilities into clearly bounded crates
concerns_zh: crate 数量与功能面庞大，升级依赖和理解整体架构的维护成本偏高
CI 使用浮动 stable 工具链且部分原生依赖较重，跨环境复现仍有漂移风险
concerns_en: The large crate and feature surface raises upgrade and architectural comprehension costs
Floating stable toolchains and some native dependencies leave reproducibility and cross-environment drift risks

projects.name: squarebox
projects.description: A curated set of modern CLI/TUI tools and AI coding assistants in a container. Batteries included.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多架构容器开发工具箱 | 安全与可持续性基线优秀
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-architecture developer toolbox with a strong security and sustainability baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人开发与团队标准化环境，生产部署应固定镜像摘要。
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individual development and standardized team environments; production deployments should pin the immutable image digest.
highlights_zh: 工具版本、校验和、APT签名密钥及OCI来源均实施固定与验证，供应链控制扎实
提供Docker/Podman、Linux/macOS/Windows及amd64/arm64支持，并具备完整CI、E2E和发布证据链
highlights_en: Pinned and verified tool versions, checksums, APT signing keys, and OCI sources provide a strong software-supply-chain baseline
Supports Docker and Podman across Linux, macOS, and Windows with amd64 and arm64 builds, backed by comprehensive CI, E2E, and release evidence
concerns_zh: ShellCheck仅启用error级别，且核心Shell脚本规模较大，后续仍需加强警告级静态检查、单元测试覆盖和跨平台回归
concerns_en: ShellCheck runs only at the error severity, and the large Shell codebase would benefit from stricter warning-level analysis, expanded unit coverage, and broader cross-platform regression testing

projects.name: hermes-agent
projects.description: The agent that grows with you
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多平台自进化代理 | 供应链治理与扩展性突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform self-improving agent with strong supply-chain governance and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 建议先审计核心执行、网关及插件代码
projects.recommendation_en: Audit the core execution, gateway, and plugin code before adoption
highlights_zh: 依赖精确锁定并按功能拆分，Python与Node工具链具备校验和缓存机制
支持多模型、多渠道、多种终端后端及插件扩展，跨平台部署能力突出
highlights_en: Dependencies are exactly pinned and feature-scoped, with verified Python and Node toolchain and cache mechanisms
Supports multiple models, messaging platforms, terminal backends, and plugins with strong cross-platform deployment
concerns_zh: 样本以文档和构建配置为主，缺少核心实现、测试覆盖与异常处理代码的直接证据
远程脚本直接管道执行存在供应链风险，且Python版本声明与“仅支持3.14”的注释存在口径差异
concerns_en: The sample is dominated by documentation and build configuration, with limited direct evidence of core implementation, test coverage, and error handling
Piping remote installers into a shell creates supply-chain risk, while the supported Python version statement conflicts with the stated 3.14-only policy

projects.name: openclaw-cn
projects.description: 中文社区版OpenClaw，同原版保持定期更新，已内置钉钉、企业微信、飞书、QQ、微信以及国内网络环境优化。你的专属个人AI助手。支持所有操作系统和平台。🦞
projects.summary_zh: 生产级本地优先多渠道助手 | 上游同步与跨平台能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade local-first assistant with strong upstream sync and cross-platform support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合国内私有化部署，投产前补充安全与测试审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for private deployment after security and test audits
highlights_zh: 提供插件 SDK、渠道插件和技能扩展机制，模块边界与扩展能力清晰
具备多架构镜像、Node 22、锁文件、发布溯源及非 root 容器化能力
通过自动化脚本持续检测上游发布并辅助分析同步变更
highlights_en: Provides a plugin SDK, channel plugins, and extensible skill architecture
Supports multi-architecture images, Node 22, lockfiles, provenance, and non-root containers
Automatically monitors upstream releases and assists synchronization analysis
concerns_zh: 所给样本主要为构建与发布配置，缺少核心业务源码和测试实现证据
Bun 通过远程脚本直接安装且未校验校验和，供应链安全不足
package.json 描述和版本信息明显滞后于 README 中的产品定位
发布流程同时配置 npm 长期令牌与 OIDC 权限，权限边界应收紧
concerns_en: The sample mainly covers build and release configuration, with limited core-source and test evidence
Bun is installed from a remote script without checksum verification, weakening supply-chain security
The package description and version metadata are stale relative to the README product scope
The release workflow combines an npm long-lived token with OIDC permissions, requiring tighter permission scoping

projects.name: ironclaw
projects.description: IronClaw is an Agent OS focused on privacy, security and extensibility
projects.summary_zh: 生产级安全Agent OS | 模块化扩展与纵深防御突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade agent OS with strong isolation and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视安全隔离与扩展性的团队，落地前需审计实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suited to security-focused teams after implementation-level audit
highlights_zh: Rust工作区按内核、领域、扩展和产品层拆分，并启用可达性与死代码检查
CI具备分层门禁、依赖闭包测试和可复现隔离执行机制
highlights_en: Rust workspace separates kernel, domain, extension, and product layers with lint guardrails
Tiered CI includes dependency-closure testing and reproducible hermetic execution
concerns_zh: README声明Rust 1.85+，但工作区实际要求Rust 1.96，文档存在漂移
安全沙箱、凭据保护和自修复等关键能力在样本中主要由文档声明，仍需核验实现
concerns_en: The README requires Rust 1.85+ while the workspace actually specifies Rust 1.96
Critical sandbox, credential-protection, and self-recovery claims remain largely documentation-based in the supplied sample

projects.name: microclaw
projects.description: 🦀An agentic AI assistant that lives in your chats, inspired by nanoclaw and incorporating some of its design ideas. Built with Rust 🦀
projects.summary_zh: 生产级自托管 Rust 智能体平台 | 模块化 SDK 与跨平台交付
projects.summary_en: Production-grade self-hosted Rust agent platform with a modular SDK and cross-platform delivery
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署与二次开发，建议先审计安全例外
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production and extension; review accepted security advisories before adoption
highlights_zh: 核心引擎、SDK、工作台与桌面应用按 workspace 清晰分层，并提供分级 feature
CI 覆盖多平台、Clippy、测试、安全审计、Nix、覆盖率及发布兼容性检查
highlights_en: The workspace cleanly separates the core engine, SDK, work runtime, and desktop apps with tiered features
CI covers multiple platforms, Clippy, tests, security audits, Nix builds, coverage, and release compatibility
concerns_zh: 安全审计显式忽略了多项 RustSec 公告，包括 quick-xml 拒绝服务风险
桌面端在非 Apple Silicon 平台仍属预览状态，生产支持边界需进一步验证
concerns_en: The security audit explicitly ignores several RustSec advisories, including a quick-xml denial-of-service risk
Desktop support outside Apple Silicon remains preview-grade and needs further production validation

projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台 AI 助手 | 安全发布与插件化工程基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform AI assistant with a strong security and release engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产采用，建议持续关注依赖升级成本
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production adoption; monitor dependency upgrade costs
highlights_zh: 基础镜像与依赖版本固定，构建可复现且供应链防护完善
发布流程具备签名验证、权限收敛、失败证明和跨平台插件选择
highlights_en: Pinned base images and dependencies enable reproducible builds with strong supply-chain controls
Release workflows combine signature verification, least privilege, failure proofs, and cross-platform plugin selection
concerns_zh: 工作流与容器构建逻辑较复杂，存在维护和审查成本
源码样本以发布基础设施为主，核心业务代码质量仍需扩大抽样验证
concerns_en: Complex workflow and container-build logic creates nontrivial maintenance and review overhead
The sample primarily covers release infrastructure, so core application quality still requires broader review

projects.name: herdr
projects.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
projects.summary_zh: 面向智能体的跨平台终端运行时，工程化与分发体系成熟
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform agent-oriented terminal runtime with mature engineering and distribution practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，建议先评估平台兼容与恢复能力
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production use after validating platform support and recovery behavior
highlights_zh: 覆盖Linux、macOS与Windows的CI及多架构制品构建
模块化Rust工作区配合测试、维护检查和文档契约校验
highlights_en: Cross-platform CI and multi-architecture artifact builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows
Modular Rust workspace with tests, maintenance checks, and documentation contract validation
concerns_zh: 缺少核心Rust源码样本，错误处理、并发安全与测试覆盖深度无法充分验证
concerns_en: Core Rust sources are absent, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and test depth

projects.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多终端编码智能体 | 扩展与安全基线完善
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-terminal coding agent with strong extension and security baselines
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试用，敏感环境需额外安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials; conduct additional security audits in sensitive environments
highlights_zh: CI覆盖测试、竞态检查、静态分析及跨平台任务，并设置最小权限
具备ACP协议、扩展机制、回滚能力及模型自选等成熟设计
highlights_en: CI combines tests, race detection, static analysis, and cross-platform jobs with least-privilege permissions
Mature design includes ACP conformance, extension mechanisms, file rewind, and model choice
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心Go实现，无法验证错误处理、并发安全及核心模块代码质量
concerns_en: The sample omits the core Go implementation, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and internal code quality

projects.name: claude-skills
projects.description: 380 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (30+ Agents, 70+ custom commands, 380+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台 AI 代理技能库 | CI 护栏完善但规模治理压力较高
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform agent skill library with strong CI guardrails but substantial scale-management overhead
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合多工具集成，落地前核验内容质量与同步机制
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-tool adoption after validating content quality and synchronization
highlights_zh: CI 覆盖语法、清单版本、路径、命名及安全审计等多层阻断门禁
Python 工具仅依赖标准库，并提供多代理平台转换与安装脚本
highlights_en: CI combines blocking syntax, manifest, path, naming, and security guardrails
Python tools use only the standard library and include multi-agent conversion and installers
concerns_zh: 仓库包含数百技能及多平台镜像树，重复内容可能增加维护与漂移风险
自动评审允许标题、标签和故障跳过，且工作流模式校验使用忽略失败策略
concerns_en: Hundreds of skills and mirrored platform trees increase maintenance and content-drift risk
Automated review permits title, label, and failure bypasses, while workflow schema validation ignores failures

projects.name: notebooklm-py
projects.description: Unofficial Python API and agentic skill for Google Gemini Notebook. Full programmatic access to Gemini Notebook's features—including capabilities the web UI doesn't expose—via Python, CLI, and AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw.
projects.summary_zh: 面向智能体的非官方多入口 Python 客户端 | 工程化完善但依赖私有接口
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered unofficial Python client with agent-oriented adapters, balanced by reliance on private APIs.
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合研究与个人项目，勿用于关键生产链路
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for research and personal projects; avoid critical production workloads.
highlights_zh: 提供 CLI、MCP、REST 服务及智能体技能等多层集成入口
具备跨平台、多 Python 版本、故障压力、安全审计和依赖审计 CI
highlights_en: Provides CLI, MCP, REST server, and agent-skill integration surfaces
Includes cross-platform, multi-version, fault-stress, security, and dependency-audit CI
concerns_zh: 依赖 Google 未公开接口，端点、认证或数据结构变化可能导致突然失效
可选依赖与实验性服务面较复杂，部分能力严格固定版本以换取兼容性
concerns_en: Relies on undocumented Google interfaces that can change without notice
Complex optional dependencies and experimental server surfaces are sometimes rigidly pinned

projects.name: xerj
projects.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.
projects.summary_zh: 成熟度较高的本地优先AI检索引擎 | 文档与工程治理完善
projects.summary_en: A mature local-first AI search engine with strong documentation and engineering governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合本地代理检索，敏感环境需启用认证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for local agent search; enable authentication in sensitive environments
highlights_zh: 单一静态二进制覆盖BM25、向量、混合检索及MCP服务
CI固定依赖提交并采用最小权限、失败开放及变更分级策略
highlights_en: Single static binary provides BM25, vector, hybrid search, and MCP serving
CI pins dependencies by commit and applies least privilege, fail-open, and change-scoping controls
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含Rust实现，核心模块质量无法直接核验
curl管道安装与--insecure模式降低了默认供应链和部署安全性
concerns_en: The sample omits Rust implementation code, preventing direct verification of core module quality
Pipe-based curl installation and the --insecure mode weaken default supply-chain and deployment security

projects.name: codeshell
projects.description: An open-source AI coding assistant for your terminal, inspired by Claude Code. Interact with your codebase directly from the command line.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化多形态 AI 编排框架 | 工程门禁完善但仍处 0.9 阶段
projects.summary_en: Modular multi-surface AI orchestration framework with strong engineering gates, still at 0.9 maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产采用前评估版本稳定性与维护容量
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; assess maturity and maintenance capacity before production adoption
highlights_zh: 核心引擎与编码能力物理解耦，统一支撑 CLI、桌面端和 SDK
CI 覆盖类型检查、安全守卫、分片测试、发布冒烟及恢复流程
highlights_en: Domain-agnostic core cleanly separated from coding capabilities and reused across CLI, desktop, and SDK
CI includes type checks, safety guards, sharded tests, package smoke tests, and release recovery
concerns_zh: 项目仍为 0.9.x，API 与发布稳定性仍需观察
仅两位贡献者且功能面广，长期维护容量存在集中风险
CI 仍依赖约 130 条 lint warning 基线，技术债务可能继续累积
concerns_en: The project remains on 0.9.x, leaving API and release stability under observation
Only two contributors support a broad product surface, creating maintenance concentration risk
CI still relies on a baseline of roughly 130 lint warnings, allowing technical debt to accumulate

projects.name: laoHuangCode
projects.description: Open-source terminal AI coding assistant with multi-provider support, MCP integration, and session management.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完善的多供应商终端编程助手，适合作为可扩展开发平台使用
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered multi-provider terminal coding assistant with strong extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视多模型接入与自动发布的团队选型
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for teams prioritizing multi-model integration and automated releases
highlights_zh: 采用严格TypeScript与模块化workspace，包边界及开发规范清晰
具备分片测试、跨平台独立构建、校验和安装恢复及可信发布流程
highlights_en: Uses strict TypeScript and modular workspaces with clear package boundaries
Provides sharded tests, cross-platform standalone builds, checksum validation, rollback, and trusted publishing
concerns_zh: 工具调用默认直接执行且无操作系统级沙箱，宿主项目面临较高安全风险
独立安装依赖Bash，Linux musl不在支持范围，跨平台能力仍存在边界
concerns_en: Tool calls execute directly without an OS-level sandbox, creating significant host-project security risk
Standalone installation requires Bash and excludes Linux musl, leaving portability gaps

projects.name: agent-zero
projects.description: Agent Zero AI framework
projects.summary_zh: 生产级容器化智能体框架 | 跨平台与扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented containerized agent framework with strong portability and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产集成，落地前审查核心代码与安全边界
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production integration after auditing core code and security boundaries
highlights_zh: 采用 Docker 多架构发布并覆盖 amd64 与 arm64，CI 同时包含发布规划和镜像构建流程
AGENTS.md 明确模块所有权、协议约束及测试方式，插件、技能和多智能体扩展边界清晰
highlights_en: Docker publishing supports amd64 and arm64, with CI planning and build workflows
AGENTS.md documents module ownership, protocol contracts, testing, and extension boundaries
concerns_zh: DockerfileLocal 使用 latest 基础镜像且未固定摘要，构建结果存在可复现性风险
根目录测试文件被 .gitignore 和 .dockerignore 排除，且本次样本缺少核心 Python 实现，无法充分验证运行时质量
concerns_en: The base image is referenced as latest without a pinned digest, reducing build reproducibility
Root-level test files are excluded by ignore rules, while core Python implementation is absent from the supplied sample

projects.name: nanobot
projects.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完备的多渠道个人智能体框架 | 插件化扩展与发布链路成熟
projects.summary_en: A production-oriented personal agent framework with mature extension and release engineering
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管部署，建议先评估依赖与渠道稳定性

concerns_en: The observed CI workflow only synchronizes branches and lacks build, test, and quality gates
Only two test groups are evident, with limited visible coverage for editor and upload failure paths
Reliance on Clawnify packages and Cloudflare D1/R2 creates deployment and maintenance coupling

projects.name: jrdev
projects.description: JrDev is a free open-source AI developer assistant for the terminal. It provides CLI/TUI interfaces to interact with LLMs for code generation, project context management, and Git operations.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化早期阶段终端 AI 编程助手 | 扩展性较好但生产保障不足
projects.summary_en: Modular early-stage terminal AI coding assistant with strong extensibility but limited production assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合早期试用，生产使用前需强化测试与异常治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for early trials; strengthen tests and failure handling before production use
highlights_zh: 核心、命令、代理、服务、提示词和界面按职责分层，模型配置与提示词支持独立扩展
CI 覆盖 Python 3.9 至 3.12，并执行单元测试与覆盖率统计
highlights_en: Clear separation across core, commands, agents, services, prompts, and UI, with independently extensible models and prompts
CI tests Python 3.9 through 3.12 and reports unit-test coverage
concerns_zh: 样本未提供核心 Python 实现，无法验证模块边界、错误处理、资源管理与实际可测试性
项目明确处于早期阶段，配置中禁用了 broad-exception-caught 等检查，且工作流未配置类型检查、静态分析和安全扫描
依赖安装使用未锁定的 requirements.txt，跨平台兼容性与可重复构建缺少明确保障
concerns_en: Core Python implementation is absent from the sample, preventing verification of module boundaries, error handling, resource management, and testability
The project is explicitly early-stage, disables broad-exception-caught checks, and does not run type checking, static analysis, or security scanning in CI
Dependencies are installed from an unpinned requirements.txt, leaving cross-platform support and reproducible builds insufficiently guaranteed

projects.name: subzeroclaw
projects.description: An agent small enough to run anywhere. A minimal agentic runtime in C — ~380 lines, 54KB binary, ~2MB RAM. A skill file + an LLM + a shell loop, no framework.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量嵌入式代理运行时 | 简洁但安全边界薄弱
projects.summary_en: Minimal embedded agent runtime with a strong simplicity bias but weak safety boundaries
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合隔离实验环境，不宜直接用于生产主机
projects.recommendation_en: Use in isolated experiments, not directly on production hosts
highlights_zh: 单文件精简架构，构建依赖少且提供系统库与内置依赖两种路径
具备单元测试、回环集成测试及持续集成验证
highlights_en: Compact single-file architecture with both system and vendored dependency paths
Includes unit tests, loopback integration tests, and CI verification
concerns_zh: 模型输出可直接执行任意Shell命令，缺少确认、沙箱与权限隔离
核心功能高度依赖外部路由器及在线LLM服务，独立降级模式缺少压缩能力
项目仅两名贡献者且发布记录为空，长期维护与版本稳定性证据不足
concerns_en: Model output can execute arbitrary shell commands without confirmation, sandboxing, or privilege isolation
Core behavior depends on an external router and online LLM service, while degraded standalone mode lacks compaction
Only two contributors and no releases provide limited evidence of long-term maintenance and release stability

projects.name: lettabot
projects.description: Archived - has been replaced by Letta Code channels/schedules!
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的多渠道 AI 助手，但项目已归档并停止维护
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-channel AI assistant with strong delivery basics but a discontinued maintenance path
projects.recommendation_zh: 仅适合存量维护，新项目优先选择Letta Code
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for maintaining existing deployments; prefer Letta Code for new projects
highlights_zh: 具备TypeScript构建、单元测试、E2E测试及Docker构建流水线
多渠道接入、CLI工具和Letta SDK集成体现出良好扩展能力
highlights_en: Includes TypeScript builds, unit and E2E tests, plus Docker-based CI
Multi-channel adapters, CLI tooling, and Letta SDK integration provide strong extensibility
concerns_zh: README明确项目已弃用且不再积极维护，新功能已迁移至Letta Code
构建后处理依赖bash与cp等Unix命令，Windows原生环境兼容性有限
patch-package执行失败会被静默忽略，可能导致补丁未生效
concerns_en: The README explicitly marks the project as deprecated and no longer actively maintained
Post-build steps rely on shell utilities such as bash and cp, limiting native Windows compatibility
Patch-package failures are silently ignored, potentially leaving required patches unapplied

projects.name: angel-claw
projects.description: Lean. Compatible. Based OpenClaw. Python ❤️ (14k downloads)
projects.summary_zh: 扩展性突出的多租户智能体平台，但生产工程基线不足
projects.summary_en: Extensible multi-tenant agent platform with insufficient production engineering baselines
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合PoC，生产使用前补齐CI与依赖锁定
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for PoC; add CI and dependency locking before production
highlights_zh: 技能注册、MCP接入与多模型适配形成清晰的扩展边界
具备多租户隔离、加密保险库、调度公平性与执行超时等安全设计
highlights_en: Skill registry, MCP integration, and multi-model support provide clear extension points
Multi-tenant isolation, encrypted vaults, fair-share scheduling, and execution timeouts show deliberate security design
concerns_zh: 缺少CI/CD与可见的自动化测试，核心实现无法从样本中核验
依赖未锁定且包含本地路径可编辑依赖，削弱构建可复现性与直接安装能力
仅一名贡献者且版本迭代较多，存在维护与知识集中风险
FastAPI、Flask与Shopyo技术边界混用，架构一致性仍需确认
concerns_en: No CI/CD or visible automated tests, and the core implementation cannot be verified from the supplied sample
Dependencies are unlocked and include a local editable path, reducing reproducibility and installability
A single contributor and frequent releases create maintenance and knowledge-concentration risk
FastAPI, Flask, and Shopyo introduce unclear architectural boundaries

projects.name: cmux
projects.description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.
projects.summary_zh: 面向AI编程代理的高活跃macOS终端 | 扩展性强但平台绑定明显
projects.summary_en: Active macOS terminal for AI coding agents with strong extensibility but tight platform coupling
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合macOS重度用户，跨平台需求需谨慎
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for macOS power users; assess carefully for cross-platform needs
highlights_zh: 原生Swift/AppKit架构，并复用Ghostty与libghostty渲染能力
提供CLI、Socket API、自定义命令及浏览器自动化接口
highlights_en: Native Swift/AppKit foundation with Ghostty and libghostty integration
Extensible through CLI, socket API, custom commands, and browser automation
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心Swift实现、测试及错误处理代码，无法验证实现质量与鲁棒性
仅支持macOS并深度依赖Ghostty、AppKit和平台原生能力
多语言README由Claude生成，翻译准确性缺少机器校验
concerns_en: The sample contains no core Swift implementation, tests, or error-handling code, preventing verification of implementation quality and robustness
macOS-only support with deep reliance on Ghostty, AppKit, and native platform capabilities
Machine-generated multilingual READMEs lack automated translation validation

projects.name: shrew
projects.summary_zh: 轻量且易扩展的多通道 Go 智能体，但命令执行与网络调用缺少关键安全边界
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, extensible Go agent with channel abstractions, but weak security boundaries around command execution and HTTP calls
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验与个人使用，生产部署前需强化沙箱和超时
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experiments and personal use; add sandboxing and timeouts before production
highlights_zh: Go 单模块结构简洁，守护进程通过 Channel 接口支持多通道扩展
提供 Makefile 交叉编译、MIT 许可证及较完整的架构与安全说明
highlights_en: A simple Go module with Channel abstractions that support extensible multi-channel integrations
Includes cross-compilation targets, an MIT license, and reasonably detailed architecture and security documentation
concerns_zh: HTTP 客户端未设置超时且未检查序列化错误，外部服务异常可能拖垮进程
命令和文件操作缺少工作目录、路径及权限约束，字符串分词还会破坏带引号参数
守护进程日志直接输出消息预览，可能泄露敏感内容，且项目无 CI/CD、贡献者和发布频率较低
concerns_en: The HTTP client has no timeout and ignores marshaling errors, so external service failures may stall the process
Command and file operations lack workspace, path, and permission boundaries, while string splitting breaks quoted arguments
Daemon logs print message previews that may expose sensitive data, and the project has no CI/CD with limited release activity

projects.name: openclaw-android-assistant
projects.description: 🦞 AnyClaw — OpenClaw + Codex + Claude Code on Android. Three AI agents in one APK. Claw Code / OpenClaude running in full Linux. No root. No server. No PC.
projects.summary_zh: 创新型移动端多智能体平台 | 工程治理尚待加强
projects.summary_en: Innovative multi-agent mobile platform with uneven engineering governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合尝鲜，暂不建议用于关键生产任务
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; not yet recommended for critical production workloads
highlights_zh: 三智能体、嵌入式 Linux 与无服务器架构形成清晰差异化
Docker 多阶段构建、镜像摘要固定及依赖覆盖提升构建可复现性
highlights_en: Clear differentiation through three agents, embedded Linux, and serverless operation
Multi-stage Docker builds, pinned image digests, and dependency overrides improve reproducibility
concerns_zh: 发布流程直接分发 debug APK，并以 npm install 回退绕过 npm ci 锁定
每小时自动合并上游并强制推送分支，冲突处理与失败恢复机制较脆弱
concerns_en: Release jobs publish debug APKs and fall back to npm install, bypassing the npm ci lock
Hourly upstream merges and force pushes have fragile conflict handling and recovery

projects.name: nanoclaw-py
projects.description: Yet another nano alternative to OpenClaw. It can read/write files, execute commands, search the web, and schedule tasks — all in ~500 lines of Python.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量教学型个人智能体 | 架构清晰但工程保障不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight educational personal agent with a clear concept but limited production safeguards
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合学习与个人原型，暂不建议直接生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for learning and personal prototypes, but not production deployment yet
highlights_zh: 依赖精简且以标准 Python 包形式组织，文档与渐进式课程完整
集成 Claude、Telegram、文件操作、命令执行与任务调度，扩展入口明确
highlights_en: Minimal dependencies, standard Python packaging, and a well-structured progressive course
Clear integration points for Claude, Telegram, file operations, command execution, and scheduling
concerns_zh: 无 CI、发布版本和可见测试体系，核心源码未出现在审计样本中
核心能力包含命令执行，但样本中未体现权限隔离、审计与沙箱机制
仅一名贡献者且多数依赖缺少严格上限，长期维护与兼容性风险较高
concerns_en: No CI, released versions, or visible test suite, and core implementation is absent from the audit sample
Command execution is a core capability, but the sample shows no permission isolation, auditing, or sandboxing
A single contributor and largely unpinned dependencies increase long-term maintenance and compatibility risk

projects.name: lossless-claw-enhanced
projects.description: Fork of Martian-Engineering/lossless-claw with CJK-aware token estimation
projects.summary_zh: 功能完善但已停止维护的 OpenClaw 上下文管理插件
projects.summary_en: A feature-complete but deprecated OpenClaw context-management plugin
projects.recommendation_zh: 新项目直接采用上游版本
projects.recommendation_en: Use the upstream project for new deployments
highlights_zh: 具备持续集成、发布流程及单元测试覆盖
提供中英文文档并明确记录功能与迁移方案
highlights_en: Includes CI, release automation, and unit-test coverage
Provides bilingual documentation with clear migration guidance
concerns_zh: 项目已弃用且不再维护，无法兼容当前 OpenClaw 版本
依赖使用通配版本并缺少严格编译检查，容器构建还会忽略构建失败
concerns_en: The deprecated project is unmaintained and incompatible with current OpenClaw releases
Wildcard dependency versions and ignored build failures weaken reproducibility

projects.name: babyclaw
projects.description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw built on Claude Agent SDK.
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的轻量个人助手 | 适合个人试用，尚未达到生产级基线
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich lightweight personal assistant | Suitable for personal use, not yet production-grade
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，生产部署前需补齐安全与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials; add security hardening and tests before production
highlights_zh: 集成官方 Claude Agent SDK 与 grammy，具备会话持久化、消息队列、中断及文件回传能力
采用 ES Module 和职责相对清晰的辅助函数，部署依赖精简且提供完整配置模板
highlights_en: Integrates the official Claude Agent SDK with grammy and provides persistence, queuing, interruption, and file delivery
Uses ES modules with relatively clear helper functions, minimal runtime dependencies, and practical configuration templates
concerns_zh: 核心逻辑集中在单个 index.js，功能持续扩张后容易形成维护瓶颈
Claude 以 bypassPermissions 运行，并允许执行高权限命令，缺少细粒度授权与隔离
状态文件采用同步非原子写入且存在空 catch，异常恢复与数据一致性不足
项目仅一名贡献者、无发布版本和 CI/CD，缺少自动化测试与发布保障
concerns_en: Core logic is concentrated in a single index.js, creating a maintenance bottleneck as features expand
Claude runs with bypassPermissions and may execute privileged commands without granular authorization or isolation
Synchronous non-atomic state writes and swallowed exceptions weaken recovery and data consistency
The project has one contributor, no tagged releases, and no CI/CD or automated test safeguards

projects.name: Aivy-OS
projects.description: Your own digital life form — local AI companion with persistent memory, IDE workspace, MCP support, and 30+ tools. Companion-first alternative to Hermes Agent / OpenClaw / Claude Code.
projects.summary_zh: 文档完整的闭源 Windows AI 助手 | 源码不可审计
projects.summary_en: Well-documented closed-source Windows AI companion with an unauditable implementation
projects.recommendation_zh: 功能适合内测，暂不建议关键生产场景
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for beta testing, not yet for critical production use
highlights_zh: 功能边界与隐私策略说明清晰
支持模型切换、MCP、插件及多模型接入
highlights_en: Clearly documented features and local-data privacy model
Supports model switching, MCP, plugins, and multiple providers
concerns_zh: 仓库仅含文档，未提供可审计源码与测试
无持续集成且贡献者仅一人，发布质量保障不足
仅支持 Windows 10/11，平台可移植性有限
concerns_en: Repository contains documentation only, with no auditable source or tests
No CI pipeline and only one contributor limit release assurance
Windows 10/11-only support restricts portability

projects.name: ZeroClaw-Android
projects.description: Run AI agents 24/7 on your Android phone. Native Rust core, 25+ providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek,         Ollama), encrypted key storage, plugin browser, Material You UI. Self-hosted alternative to Mac Mini setups. MIT           licensed.
projects.summary_zh: 已归档的实验性 Android 自托管 AI 代理客户端
projects.summary_en: An archived experimental Android client for self-hosted AI agents
projects.recommendation_zh: 不建议用于生产或安全敏感场景
projects.recommendation_en: Not recommended for production or security-sensitive use
highlights_zh: 原生 Android 自托管定位并支持多种模型提供商
MIT 许可便于研究、复用与二次开发
highlights_en: Targets native Android self-hosting with multiple model providers
Uses an MIT license to facilitate research and reuse
concerns_zh: 项目已明确归档，项目维护者同时指出代码几乎完全由 AI 生成且存在安全风险
仅一名贡献者且无 CI/CD，缺少持续集成与自动化质量保障
当前样本仅包含归档说明，无法验证 Rust 核心、密钥加密、插件机制及提供商适配的实现质量
concerns_en: The project is explicitly archived, with the maintainer citing an almost entirely AI-generated codebase and unresolved safety risks
Only one contributor and no CI/CD leave the project without continuous integration or automated quality checks
The provided sample contains only an archive notice, so implementation quality cannot be verified
